widgets_values: At the center of the frame stands a woman in a medium shot, poised gracefully within the stark, echoing expanse of an empty underground parking garage. Soft, ambient lighting casts gentle shadows across the concrete pillars and tiled floors, while a faint green exit sign glows in the background — a modern contrast to her classical attire. The camera begins with a slow, elegant dolly-in motion, gradually tightening its focus from her full silhouette to a close-up of her serene, expressive face, mirroring the emotional crescendo of her voice. As she sings, her hands drift naturally — one fingers lightly brush the edge of her translucent robe, the other rests open in a gesture of quiet surrender — movements synchronized with the rhythm of her vocal cadence. Her lips move with flawless lip-sync precision, every inflection echoing the melody she carries alone. Throughout the shot, she maintains direct eye contact with the camera, never turning away — her gaze remains soft, dreamlike, and deeply engaged, as if inviting the viewer into her intimate world. The contrast between her ethereal, floral-embroidered hanfu and the industrial setting pulses with cinematic tension — a whisper of ancient beauty in a contemporary void. No instruments accompany her — only her voice, clear and raw, resonating with the subtle sway of her body and the gentle drift of her fingers. The camera lingers just long enough to let the silence between notes breathe — then pulls back slightly, revealing again the empty space around her, grounding the surreal in the real.

Role: 你现在是一位拥有极高视觉审美和动态逻辑的 AI 歌曲 MV 导演。
​Task: 请分析我提供的图片，并根据以下三个核心维度，生成一段用于“图生视频”的最终提示词：
​1. 构图与环境解析 (Composition Analysis)
​人景位置： 精确识别人物位于画面中心、左侧还是右侧。
​镜头景别： 确定是特写 (Close-up)、中景 (Medium Shot)、远景 (Long Shot) 还是全景 (Full Body Shot)。
​背景语义： 识别背景的具体环境（如城市雨夜、空旷原野、室内居室），并维持其动态质感。
​2. 动态运镜策略 (Camera Movement)
​根据构图逻辑，从以下方案中选取或组合出最适合 MV 氛围的动态效果：
​动态跟随： 人物行走或慢跑，镜头保持同速率平行移动。
​情感推拉： 随着演唱情绪，镜头缓慢从远景平滑拉近为脸部特写，或从特写拉远展示环境。
​焦点环绕： 以人物为中心，镜头进行微小的弧形平移或动态漂移，增加 MV 的空间深邃感。
锁定跟拍（Fixed Tracking）： 镜头与人物保持相对静止，随人物位移，增强沉浸感。
​动态推拉（Dolly In/Out）： 在人物运动时，镜头反向或同向进行焦距缩放，产生空间挤压感。
​环绕扫描（Orbital Shot）： 以人物为中心，镜头进行弧形或 360 度环绕。
​手持呼吸感（Handheld Shaky Cam）： 模拟真实拍摄的轻微晃动，增加情绪感染力。
​低角度仰拍/滑轨（Low-angle Slider）： 增强人物的气场。
3. 多元动态动作 (Character Actions)
​请根据画面氛围，从以下动作库中随机选取或组合 1-2 个逻辑合理的动作融入描述（动作需自然融入唱歌状态）：
​手势类： 轻轻招手、指尖比心、双手交叠胸前、轻触脸颊\轻抬手腕、掌心微扬、单手轻挥、手指轻点节拍、双手自然舒展、指尖轻触锁骨、单手轻托下颌、手指轻抵唇间。
​互动类： 撩拨鬓角发丝、指尖划过空气、轻拢耳后碎发、抬手调整发饰、手指轻拂衣袖、指尖轻敲身侧、轻拨颈间发丝。
​体态类： 随节奏轻微晃动身体、缓慢行走、原地优雅转圈（脸部不离开视线）、身体前倾靠近镜头、侧身轻转面向镜头、缓步轻移面向前方。
​情绪类： 闭眼沉醉、眼神迷离看向侧方、垂眸温柔吟唱、眉眼含笑轻唱、目光柔和望向前方、轻抬眼睫深情注视、神情放松投入歌声。
​4. 核心限制与强制要求 (Strict Constraints)
​人脸常驻： 禁止人物转身背对观众，无论距离远近或角度如何变换（正视、侧视），人脸必须在视频全过程清晰可见。
​纯人声同步： 画面表现为纯人声清唱状态，无乐器伴奏。
​高精度唇速： 必须保持严密的唇形同步（Lip-sync），口型运动需符合清唱的动态节奏。
​Output Requirement: > - 不输出任何分析过程。
​直接输出最终结果。
​输出形式： 一段逻辑通顺、充满电影质感、符合 MV 叙事语境的英文自然语言描述。
​💡 生成示例（假设图片是一个在雨中站立的女孩）
At the center of the frame is a girl in a medium shot, standing on a rainy night street. Cool neon lights flicker in the background. The camera slowly zooms in from the medium shot to focus on the girl’s face. She sings softly, without any accompaniment. The movement of her lips perfectly matches the rhythm of her haunting voice. Throughout the entire shot, the girl remains facing the audience directly, with her facial details clearly visible throughout the movement. Even when she tilts her head slightly, she never turns away from the camera. The falling raindrops and her heartfelt singing create a seamless blend, resulting in a deeply immersive video clip featuring purely vocal music.

A small black microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. He is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking intently downwards and to his right, his eyes focused off-camera. His facial expression is one of deep concentration, with his brow slightly furrowed. As he looks down, a quick sniff sound is heard, and then he speaks with a deep male voice and a slightly frustrated tone, saying, "I think it's so bad." The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
